image.build_notes: Built from PR #74 commit ea479f076c71af9ce725700cc86ab307fc38a81d on the isolated bench daemon with the legacy builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, --network host). VLLM_REPOSITORY was overridden to the local git daemon at git://127.0.0.1:9418/vllm-hist.git. The build fetched the content-locked source archive, copied sanitized Base history with directory-qualified .git paths, and passed the repository's image-check.
